original.statement: The `-compactor.delete-request-store` CLI flag or its YAML configuration setting must be explicitly configured when retention is enabled in Loki 3.0.0, as it is required for storing delete requests.

corrected.statement: When retention is enabled, -compactor.delete-request-store (or its YAML setting delete_request_store) must now be explicitly configured; it is required for storing delete requests.

decision.reason: [ev-e598abf2a6cd] says `-compactor.delete-request-store` (or its YAML setting) "should be explicitly configured when retention is enabled, this is required for storing delete requests", so now-required is the right change type. For the subject, the text names only the flag. "compactor" appears only as part of the flag's own name, and the text never names a separate compactor component or binary that owns the flag. Because of that, the component field should be left out and the flag name copied exactly as written.
